#DBN all groups bootstrap results ensemble
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
# 加载数据
load("~/RNAseq/RNAseq_FULL_MODEL/combined time/DBN_results/DBN_Optimized_Results_HPC.RData")

# 直接从valid_results提取数据
all_edges_list <- lapply(valid_results, function(res) {
  if(!is.null(res$bootstrap_stats) && nrow(res$bootstrap_stats) > 0){
    stats <- res$bootstrap_stats
    stats$group_id <- res$group_name
    stats$lncRNA <- res$lnc_display_name 
    return(stats)
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
})

# 移除NULL结果
all_edges_list <- all_edges_list[!sapply(all_edges_list, is.null)]

cat("Processed", length(all_edges_list), "groups with bootstrap stats\n")

# 合并大表格
if(length(all_edges_list) > 0) {
  raw_network_table <- do.call(rbind, all_edges_list)
  cat("Raw table rows:", nrow(raw_network_table), "\n")
  
  # Ensemble Voting - 首先检查所有必需的列是否存在
  cat("Performing Ensemble Voting...\n")
  
  # 检查列是否存在
  required_cols <- c("lncRNA", "gene", "group_id", "bootstrap_frequency", "consensus_relationship")
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(raw_network_table))
  
  if(length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(paste("Missing required columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  
  final_network_table <- raw_network_table %>%
    group_by(lncRNA, gene) %>%
    summarise(
      n_groups_positive = n_distinct(group_id),
      avg_freq_when_found = mean(bootstrap_frequency),
      max_group_freq = max(bootstrap_frequency),
      final_relationship = names(sort(table(consensus_relationship), decreasing=TRUE))[1],
      # 保留所有原始列的信息
      all_group_ids = paste(unique(group_id), collapse = ";"),
      all_bootstrap_freqs = paste(round(bootstrap_frequency, 3), collapse = ";"),
      all_relationships = paste(unique(consensus_relationship), collapse = ";"),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    # 计算置信等级
    mutate(
      Confidence_Tier = case_when(
        n_groups_positive >= 20 & avg_freq_when_found >= 0.8 ~ "Gold (High Robustness)",
        n_groups_positive >= 15 & avg_freq_when_found >= 0.7 ~ "Silver (Reproducible)",
        n_groups_positive >= 10 & avg_freq_when_found >= 0.9 ~ "Bronze (Context-Specific)",
        TRUE ~ "Discard"
      )
    ) %>%
    # 只保留 Gold, Silver, Bronze
    filter(Confidence_Tier != "Discard") %>%
    arrange(desc(n_groups_positive))
  
  
  # 直接计算并添加到现有的 final_network_table
final_network_table <- final_network_table %>%
  mutate(
    n_groups_tested = sapply(strsplit(all_group_ids, ";"), length),  # 从all_group_ids计算测试组数
    total_evidence_score = sapply(strsplit(all_bootstrap_freqs, ";"), function(x) {
      sum(as.numeric(x))  # 从all_bootstrap_freqs计算总证据分数
    }),
    global_consistency_score = total_evidence_score / n_groups_tested  # 计算全局一致性分数
  ) %>%
  # 重新排序列，让新计算的列在一起
  dplyr::select(lncRNA, gene, n_groups_positive, n_groups_tested, total_evidence_score, global_consistency_score,
         avg_freq_when_found, max_group_freq, everything())

# 查看计算结果
cat("Global consistency score statistics:\n")
cat("Min:", min(final_network_table$global_consistency_score, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Mean:", mean(final_network_table$global_consistency_score, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Max:", max(final_network_table$global_consistency_score, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

cat("\nTop 10 interactions by global consistency score:\n")
top_consistent <- final_network_table %>%
  arrange(desc(global_consistency_score)) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  dplyr::select(lncRNA, gene, n_groups_tested, total_evidence_score, global_consistency_score, Confidence_Tier)
print(top_consistent)

# 保存更新后的表格
save(final_network_table, file = "Final_Robust_LncRNA_Network_Ensemble_HPC.RData")
write.csv(final_network_table, "Final_Robust_LncRNA_Network_Ensemble_HPC.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  
  
} else {
  cat("No valid bootstrap statistics found in the results!\n")
}

final_network_table <- final_network_table %>%
  mutate(Biological_Role = case_when(
    # 1. 明确的下游靶点
    final_relationship == "lnc_regulates_gene" ~ "Downstream Target",
    
    # 2. 明确的上游调节者
    final_relationship == "gene_regulates_lnc" ~ "Upstream Modulator",
    
    # 3. 正相关 -> 升级为“功能协作者”
    final_relationship == "associated_pos" ~ "Synergistic Partner",
    
    # 4. 负相关 -> 升级为“竞争性/抑制性伴侣”
    final_relationship == "associated_neg" ~ "Repressive Partner",
    
    TRUE ~ "Unknown"
  ))

print(table(final_network_table$Confidence_Tier))
cat("Aggregation completed!\n")

# --- 提取目标基因并保留所有信息 ---
cat("\n=== Extracting Top Genes with Complete Information ===\n")

# 步骤 1: 筛选目标基因（保留所有置信等级）
cat("Filtering for Gold/Silver/Bronze targets...\n")
targets_to_fetch <- final_network_table %>%
  filter(Confidence_Tier == "Gold (High Robustness)", avg_freq_when_found == 1)

# 确保有目标
if(nrow(targets_to_fetch) == 0) stop("No targets found! Check filtering.")
cat("Total targets to fetch:", nrow(targets_to_fetch), "\n")

# 检查 targets_to_fetch 的列
cat("Columns in targets_to_fetch:", paste(colnames(targets_to_fetch), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# 步骤 2: 构建索引
cat("Building lookup index...\n")
gene_lookup_idx <- list()
idx_count <- 0

total_groups <- length(valid_results)
pb_idx <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = total_groups, style = 3)

for(i in 1:total_groups) {
  res <- valid_results[[i]]
  
  if(!is.null(res) && !is.null(res$integrated_results$temporal_evidence)) {
    lnc <- res$lnc_display_name
    evidence_list <- res$integrated_results$temporal_evidence
    genes_in_this_group <- names(evidence_list)
    
    for(g in genes_in_this_group) {
      key <- paste0(lnc, "|", g)
      if(is.null(gene_lookup_idx[[key]])) {
        gene_lookup_idx[[key]] <- i
        idx_count <- idx_count + 1
      }
    }
  }
  if(i %% 100 == 0) setTxtProgressBar(pb_idx, i)
}
close(pb_idx)
cat("\nIndex built with", idx_count, "entries.\n")

# 步骤 3: 提取 Lag 数据并保留所有原始信息
final_ranking_list <- list()
match_count <- 0

cat("Extracting Lag stats with complete information...\n")
pb_ext <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = nrow(targets_to_fetch), style = 3)

for(k in 1:nrow(targets_to_fetch)) {
  
  curr_lnc <- targets_to_fetch$lncRNA[k]
  curr_gene <- targets_to_fetch$gene[k]
  
  key <- paste0(curr_lnc, "|", curr_gene)
  grp_idx <- gene_lookup_idx[[key]]
  
  if(!is.null(grp_idx)) {
    res <- valid_results[[grp_idx]]
    evidence <- res$integrated_results$temporal_evidence[[curr_gene]]
    
    if(!is.null(evidence) && !is.null(evidence$lag)) {
      
      # 安全地获取所有列的值
      row_data <- data.frame(
        # 基本信息
        lncRNA = curr_lnc,
        gene = curr_gene,
        
        # 统计信息
        n_groups_positive = targets_to_fetch$n_groups_positive[k],
        avg_freq_when_found = targets_to_fetch$avg_freq_when_found[k],
        max_group_freq = targets_to_fetch$max_group_freq[k],
        final_relationship = targets_to_fetch$final_relationship[k],
        
        # 分组信息（安全获取）
        all_group_ids = if("all_group_ids" %in% colnames(targets_to_fetch)) targets_to_fetch$all_group_ids[k] else NA,
        all_bootstrap_freqs = if("all_bootstrap_freqs" %in% colnames(targets_to_fetch)) targets_to_fetch$all_bootstrap_freqs[k] else NA,
        all_relationships = if("all_relationships" %in% colnames(targets_to_fetch)) targets_to_fetch$all_relationships[k] else NA,
        
        # 置信等级
        Confidence_Tier = targets_to_fetch$Confidence_Tier[k],
        Biological_Role = targets_to_fetch$Biological_Role[k],
        
        # Lag 统计信息
        best_lag = evidence$lag$best_lag,
        lag_cor = evidence$lag$max_correlation,
        lag_p = evidence$lag$pvalue,
        
        # 其他可能有用的信息
        group_id_matched = res$group_name,
        
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
        check.names = FALSE
      )
      
      final_ranking_list[[length(final_ranking_list) + 1]] <- row_data
      match_count <- match_count + 1
    }
  }
  setTxtProgressBar(pb_ext, k)
}
close(pb_ext)

cat("\nExtraction matched:", match_count, "genes.\n")

# 步骤 4: 合并与保存
if(length(final_ranking_list) > 0) {
  all_lnc_top_targets <- do.call(rbind, final_ranking_list)
  
  # 排序：置信等级 -> P值 -> 相关性
  if("Confidence_Tier" %in% colnames(all_lnc_top_targets)) {
    all_lnc_top_targets <- all_lnc_top_targets %>% 
      arrange(desc(Confidence_Tier), lag_p, desc(abs(lag_cor)))
  } else {
    all_lnc_top_targets <- all_lnc_top_targets %>% arrange(lag_p)
  }
  
  # 保存完整结果
  save(all_lnc_top_targets, file = "All_LncRNAs_Top_Targets_Complete_Info.RData")
  write.csv(all_lnc_top_targets, "All_LncRNAs_Top_Targets_Complete_Info.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  
  cat("Success! Complete results saved to:\n")
  cat("- All_LncRNAs_Top_Targets_Complete_Info.RData\n")
  cat("- All_LncRNAs_Top_Targets_Complete_Info.csv\n")
  
  # 输出统计信息
  cat("\n=== Final Results Summary ===\n")
  cat("Total interactions:", nrow(all_lnc_top_targets), "\n")
  if("Confidence_Tier" %in% colnames(all_lnc_top_targets)) {
    cat("Confidence Tier distribution:\n")
    print(table(all_lnc_top_targets$Confidence_Tier))
  }
  cat("\nTop 10 interactions:\n")
  print(head(all_lnc_top_targets, 10))
  
} else {
  stop("Final list is empty. Please check if genes in 'final_network_table' actually exist in 'valid_results'.")
}
```

#degree
```{r}
load("~/RNAseq/RNAseq_FULL_MODEL/combined time/results/sig_genes_21_to_28.RData")
dox_response_gene <- unique(sig_genes_21_to_28$gene_name)
# 计算每个基因的“受欢迎程度” (Degree)
gene_degree <- all_lnc_top_targets %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(
    n_lncRNAs = n_distinct(lncRNA),
    lncRNAs_list = paste(unique(lncRNA), collapse = ", ")
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_lncRNAs))

# 查看 Top 10 "Super-Hubs"
print(head(gene_degree, 20))

all_lnc_top_targets <- all_lnc_top_targets %>%
  left_join(gene_degree, by = "gene")

# 可视化：度分布图
ggplot(gene_degree, aes(x = n_lncRNAs)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#377EB8") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Combinatorial Regulation",
    x = "Number of LncRNAs Regulating a Gene",
    y = "Count of Genes"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:18)

ggsave("~/RNAseq/RNAseq_FULL_MODEL/combined time/DBN_results/figures/Distribution of Combinatorial Regulation.pdf", 
       width = 5, height = 5, limitsize = FALSE)


# 确保 all_lnc_top_targets 里已经有了 n_lncRNAs 列 (基于你之前的 left_join)
# 如果没有，重新运行一遍 degree 计算：
if(!"n_lncRNAs" %in% colnames(all_lnc_top_targets)) {
  gene_degree <- all_lnc_top_targets %>%
    group_by(gene) %>%
    mutate(n_lncRNAs = n_distinct(lncRNA)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  all_lnc_top_targets <- gene_degree
}

# 分类并统计
plot_data <- all_lnc_top_targets %>%
  # 定义分类：Degree=1 为 Specific，其他为 Shared
  mutate(Target_Category = ifelse(n_lncRNAs == 1, 
                                  "Specific Targets (Degree=1)", 
                                  "Shared Targets (Degree>1)")) %>%
  # 统计每个 lncRNA 在每个分类下的基因数量
  group_by(lncRNA, Target_Category) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = 'drop')


# 为了图表好看，我们按照 "Specific Targets" 的数量从多到少排序
# 这样左边是“专家型”，右边是“通用型”

order_df <- plot_data %>%
  filter(Target_Category == "Specific Targets (Degree=1)") %>%
  arrange(desc(Count))

lnc_levels <- order_df$lncRNA

# 把那些没有 Specific Target 的 lncRNA (如果有的话) 补在最后
remaining_lncs <- setdiff(unique(plot_data$lncRNA), lnc_levels)
lnc_levels <- c(lnc_levels, remaining_lncs)

# 应用排序
plot_data$lncRNA <- factor(plot_data$lncRNA, levels = lnc_levels)
# 调整 Category 的因子顺序，让 Specific 在下面（或上面），看个人喜好
plot_data$Target_Category <- factor(plot_data$Target_Category, 
                                    levels = c("Shared Targets (Degree>1)", "Specific Targets (Degree=1)"))



p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = lncRNA, y = Count, fill = Target_Category)) +
  
  # 绘制堆叠柱状图
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.7, color = "black", size = 0.2) +
  
  # 添加数字标签 (可选，如果数字太小挤在一起就去掉)
  geom_text(aes(label = Count), 
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), 
            size = 3, color = "white", fontface = "bold") +
  
  # 配色方案 (红蓝配色，对比强烈)
  # Specific 用醒目的颜色(红/深色)，Shared 用基础色(灰/浅色)
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Specific Targets (Degree=1)" = "#E64B35", # NPG Red
                               "Shared Targets (Degree>1)" = "#8491B4")) + # NPG Blue/Grey
  
  # 坐标轴与标题
  labs(title = "Regulatory Architecture: Specificity vs. Redundancy",
       subtitle = "Number of unique (degree=1) vs. shared (degree>1) targets per lncRNA",
       x = NULL,
       y = "Number of Target Genes",
       fill = "Target Type") +
  
  # 主题优化
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30")
  )


ggsave("Fig_Target_Specificity_StackedBar.pdf", p, width = 10, height = 6)
print(p)
```

#superhub gene heatmap
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
super_hubs <- gene_degree %>%
  filter(n_lncRNAs >= 9) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_lncRNAs))

print(super_hubs)

ids <- bitr(super_hubs$gene, fromType="SYMBOL", toType="GENENAME", OrgDb="org.Hs.eg.db")
print(ids)

super_hubs <- super_hubs %>%
  left_join(ids, by = c("gene" = "SYMBOL"))

# 1. 筛选 super hub 基因相关的互作
super_hub_genes <- super_hubs$gene
# 1. 准备矩阵数据
heatmap_data <- all_lnc_top_targets %>%
  filter(gene %in% super_hub_genes) %>%
  dplyr::select(lncRNA, gene, lag_cor)

# 2. 获取基因注释用于Y轴标签 (可选，如果基因名太长就只用 Symbol)
gene_labels <- super_hubs %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, GENENAME) %>%
  distinct()

# 3. 绘制热图
# 如果想让热图自动聚类（让相似调控模式的基因靠在一起），可以使用 pheatmap 或 ComplexHeatmap
# 下面是 ggplot 的简单聚类实现：
# 计算聚类顺序
mat <- reshape2::acast(heatmap_data, gene ~ lncRNA, value.var = "lag_cor", fill = 0)
ord_gene <- hclust(dist(mat))$order
ord_lnc <- hclust(dist(t(mat)))$order

# 重排序 factor
heatmap_data$gene <- factor(heatmap_data$gene, levels = rownames(mat)[ord_gene])
heatmap_data$lncRNA <- factor(heatmap_data$lncRNA, levels = colnames(mat)[ord_lnc])

# 重新绘图（带聚类顺序）
p_heatmap_clustered <- ggplot(heatmap_data, aes(x = lncRNA, y = gene, fill = lag_cor)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "#F7F7F7", high = "#B2182B") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Clustered Regulation Map of Super Hubs")

ggsave("Super_Hubs_Heatmap.pdf", p_heatmap_clustered, width = 10, height = max(8, length(super_hub_genes)*0.15))

library(ggraph)
library(igraph)


super_hub_network <- all_lnc_top_targets %>%
  filter(gene %in% super_hub_genes) %>%
  # 为每个super hub基因选择相关性最强的8个lncRNA
  group_by(gene) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = abs(lag_cor), n = 8) %>%
  ungroup()

edges_super <- data.frame(
  from = super_hub_network$lncRNA,
  to = super_hub_network$gene,
  weight = abs(super_hub_network$lag_cor),
  correlation = super_hub_network$lag_cor,
  p_value = super_hub_network$lag_p,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat("Edges data frame created with", nrow(edges_super), "rows\n")

nodes_super <- data.frame(
  name = unique(c(edges_super$from, edges_super$to)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# 添加节点类型
nodes_super$type <- ifelse(nodes_super$name %in% edges_super$from, "LncRNA",
                          ifelse(nodes_super$name %in% super_hub_genes, "Super_Hub_Gene", "Gene"))

# 计算节点度
nodes_super$degree <- sapply(nodes_super$name, function(x) {
  sum(edges_super$from == x) + sum(edges_super$to == x)
})
# 使用你之前处理好的 edges_super 和 nodes_super

# 1. 强制定义布局坐标 (手动设置)
# 分离 lncRNA 和 Gene
lnc_nodes <- nodes_super$name[nodes_super$type == "LncRNA"]
gene_nodes <- nodes_super$name[nodes_super$type != "LncRNA"]

# 创建坐标数据框
layout_df <- data.frame(name = c(lnc_nodes, gene_nodes))

# 设置 Y 轴：LncRNA 在顶部 (y=1)，Gene 在底部 (y=0)
layout_df$y <- ifelse(layout_df$name %in% lnc_nodes, 1, 0)

# 设置 X 轴：均匀分布
layout_df$x <- 0
layout_df$x[layout_df$y == 1] <- seq(0, 100, length.out = length(lnc_nodes))
layout_df$x[layout_df$y == 0] <- seq(0, 100, length.out = length(gene_nodes))

# 2. 创建图对象
g_bipartite <- graph_from_data_frame(edges_super, vertices = nodes_super)

# 3. 绘图 (使用自定义布局)
create_layout(g_bipartite, layout = "manual", x = layout_df$x, y = layout_df$y) %>%
  ggraph() +
  # 连线：使用曲线，根据相关性着色
  geom_edge_diagonal(aes(color = correlation, alpha = abs(correlation)), width = 0.5) +
  scale_edge_color_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "grey90", high = "red") +
  
  # 节点：LncRNA
  geom_node_point(aes(filter = type == "LncRNA"), size = 5, color = "#E41A1C") +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = name, filter = type == "LncRNA"), 
                 nudge_y = 0.1, fontface = "bold", size = 4) +
  
  # 节点：Genes
  geom_node_point(aes(filter = type != "LncRNA", size = degree), color = "#377EB8") +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = name, filter = type != "LncRNA"), 
                 angle = 90, hjust = 1, nudge_y = -0.05, size = 3) +
  
  # 设置画布范围，防止标签被切
  expand_limits(y = c(-0.5, 1.5)) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = "Bipartite Regulatory Architecture", 
       subtitle = "Top: LncRNAs | Bottom: Super Hub Genes")

ggsave("Super_Hubs_Bipartite.pdf", width = 12, height = 8)

```

#DBN 结果是特异的还是共线性
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggrepel)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. 数据准备
# ==============================================================================

# A. 确保我们有 206 个 Dox 基因的列表
# 假设你的 206 个基因列表叫 dox_response_gene
if(!exists("dox_response_gene")) {
  stop("请提供 dox_response_gene 向量 (206个基因名)")
}

# B. 确定哪些基因最终被纳入了网络 (High Confidence Targets)
# 假设 all_lnc_top_targets 是你最终过滤好的表
network_genes <- unique(all_lnc_top_targets$gene)

# C. 计算这 206 个基因在原始分析中的最高 Frequency
# (我们需要回到 raw_network_table 找那些被淘汰基因的“真实得分”)
# 如果基因在 raw_network_table 里没出现过，说明 Frequency = 0

dox_specificity_data <- data.frame(gene = dox_response_gene) %>%
  # 标记是否被最终纳入
  mutate(Status = ifelse(gene %in% network_genes, 
                         "LncRNA-Network Targets\n(Included)", 
                         "LncRNA-Independent\n(Excluded)"))

# 从 raw_network_table 中提取每个基因的最高 Frequency
raw_freq_stats <- raw_network_table %>%
  filter(gene %in% dox_response_gene) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(
    Bootstrap_Freq = mean(bootstrap_frequency), # 取它在所有组里最高的那个频率
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# 合并数据 (没找到的基因 Freq 设为 0)
dox_specificity_data <- dox_specificity_data %>%
  left_join(raw_freq_stats, by = "gene") %>%
  mutate(Bootstrap_Freq = ifelse(is.na(Bootstrap_Freq), 0, Bootstrap_Freq))

# ==============================================================================
# 2. 绘图 A: 数量分布 (Donut Chart or Bar Chart)
# ==============================================================================

count_data <- dox_specificity_data %>%
  group_by(Status) %>%
  summarise(Count = n()) %>%
  mutate(Percentage = Count / sum(Count) * 100)

p1 <- ggplot(count_data, aes(x = "", y = Count, fill = Status)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1, color = "white") +
  coord_polar("y", start = 0) +
  theme_void() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("LncRNA-Independent\n(Excluded)" = "grey70",
```

```{r}
library(enrichR)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

# 1. 准备数据：只分析至少有 5 个特异基因的 lncRNA
# 假设 specific_targets 是你之前生成的表格 (lncRNA, gene, degree)
lncs_to_analyze <- lnc_specificity_count %>% 
  filter(n_specific_genes >= 5) %>% 
  pull(lncRNA)

specific_gene_list <- split(specific_targets$gene, specific_targets$lncRNA)
specific_gene_list <- specific_gene_list[lncs_to_analyze]

# 2. 定义要查询的数据库组合 (组合拳)
dbs <- c(
#  "KEGG_2021_Human",                   # 通路
  "Reactome_2022",                     # 详细通路
  "MSigDB_Hallmark_2020",              # 核心生物学状态 (最容易出结果)
  "GO_Biological_Process_2025"         # 再次尝试 GO
#  "ChEA_2022",
#  "HDSigDB_Human_2021",
#  "TF_Perturbations_Followed_by_Expression"                                   # 转录因子机制
)

# 3. 循环分析
combined_enrichment <- data.frame()

cat("Starting multi-database enrichment...\n")
# 连接 Enrichr (需要联网)
if(length(dbs) > 0) {
    for(lnc in names(specific_gene_list)) {
      genes <- specific_gene_list[[lnc]]
      
      tryCatch({
        enriched <- enrichr(genes, dbs)
        
        for(db in dbs) {
          res <- enriched[[db]]
          # 稍微放宽一点标准，P value < 0.1 也可以先看看，或者严格 < 0.05
          sig_res <- res %>% filter(Adjusted.P.value < 0.05) 
          
          if(nrow(sig_res) > 0) {
            # 取最显著的前 3 个
            top_terms <- sig_res %>% slice_head(n = 5) %>%
              mutate(LncRNA = lnc, Database = db)
            
            combined_enrichment <- rbind(combined_enrichment, top_terms)
          }
        }
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("Error analyzing", lnc, ":", e$message, "\n")
      })
      cat(".")
    }
}
cat("\nDone!\n")

# 4. 数据清洗与美化
if(nrow(combined_enrichment) > 0) {
  
  plot_data <- combined_enrichment %>%
    # 清洗 Term 名字 (去掉 (GO:xxxx) 这种后缀)
    mutate(Term = str_remove(Term, " \\(GO:.*\\)")) %>%
    mutate(Term = str_remove(Term, " R-HSA.*")) %>% 
    # 计算 -log10 P
    mutate(LogP = -log10(Adjusted.P.value)) %>%
    # 截断太长的名字
    mutate(Term_Short = str_trunc(Term, 60))
  
  # 5. 可视化：分面气泡图
  # 我们按数据库分面，这样可以看出不同维度的富集
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = LncRNA, y = Term_Short, size = LogP, color = Database)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
    facet_grid(Database ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 8), name = "-log10(Adj.P)") +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(title = "Multi-dimensional Functional Specificity",
         x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
   #   strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  # 保存
  ggsave("Fig_LncRNA_Multi_Enrichment.pdf", p, width = 8, height = 10) # 长一点，因为条目多
  print(p)
  
} else {
  cat("No significant enrichment found even with multiple databases.\n")
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(enrichR)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

# 计算 Degree
gene_degree_info <- all_lnc_top_targets %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  mutate(degree = n_distinct(lncRNA)) %>%
  ungroup()

# A. 提取核心 (Global Core, >= 5)
core_genes <- gene_degree_info %>%
  filter(degree >= 5) %>%
  pull(gene) %>%
  unique()

# B. 提取非核心 (Non-Core, < 5)
# 这里包含了 Degree 1, 2, 3, 4
non_core_data <- gene_degree_info %>%
  filter(degree ==1)

# 关键步骤：构建分析列表
# 对于 Degree 2-4 的基因，它会出现在多个 lncRNA 的列表中，这是正确的
analysis_list <- split(non_core_data$gene, non_core_data$lncRNA)

# 把 Core 加进去
analysis_list[["CONSENSUS_CORE"]] <- core_genes

# 过滤掉基因太少的组 (比如少于 10 个基因的 lncRNA 不做富集)
analysis_list <- analysis_list[sapply(analysis_list, length) >= 5]

cat("Analysis Groups:\n")
print(sapply(analysis_list, length))

# 2. 定义数据库
dbs <- c("MSigDB_Hallmark_2020", 
         "Reactome_2022", 
         "TF_Perturbations_Followed_by_Expression")

# 3. 批量运行 EnrichR
all_enrichment_results <- data.frame()

cat("Running enrichment...\n")
for(group_name in names(analysis_list)) {
  genes <- analysis_list[[group_name]]
  
  if(length(genes) > 0) {
    tryCatch({
      enriched <- enrichr(genes, dbs)
      
      for(db in dbs) {
        res <- enriched[[db]]
        # 筛选显著的 (P < 0.05)
        sig_res <- res %>% filter(Adjusted.P.value < 0.05)
        
        if(nrow(sig_res) > 0) {
          sig_res$Group <- group_name
          sig_res$Database <- db
          all_enrichment_results <- rbind(all_enrichment_results, sig_res)
        }
      }
    }, error = function(e) cat("Error in", group_name, "\n"))
  }
}

# 保存原始结果 (作为附件 Supp Table)
write.csv(all_enrichment_results, "Full_Enrichment_Results_Raw.csv")
cat("Raw results saved. Now comes the curation part.\n")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. 定义关键词与标准化映射 (核心修改)
# ==============================================================================
# 我们不仅用它来分类，还用它来把 Term 名字缩短成“核心概念”

keywords_map <- list(
  "1_Stemness_Core" = c("POU5F1", "OCT4", "SOX2", "NANOG", "MYC", "KLF4", "Major"),
  "2_Epigenetic_Mech" = c("EZH2", "SUZ12", "TET1", "TET2", "TET3", "DNMT"),
  "3_Differentiation" = c("NEUROG", "Nervous", "Neuronal", "Axon", "GABA", "Epithelial Mesenchymal"),
  "4_Stress_Death" = c("TNF", "NF-kB", "NFKB", "Apoptosis", "TP53", "Mitochondrial", "STAT3")
)

# 展平用于过滤
flattened_keywords <- unlist(keywords_map)
regex_pattern <- paste(flattened_keywords, collapse = "|")

# ==============================================================================
# 2. 数据处理与智能去重
# ==============================================================================

# A. 基础过滤 (人类相关 + 关键词命中)
filtered_data <- all_enrichment_results %>%
  filter(!grepl("mouse|rat|musculus|rattus|drosophila|yeast|zebrafish", Term, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(grepl(regex_pattern, Term, ignore.case = TRUE))

# B. 核心步骤：语义归纳 (Semantic Mapping)
# 这里我们将复杂的句子转化为简单的核心词
clean_data <- filtered_data %>%
  mutate(Term_Display = Term) %>% 
  
  # --- 规则 1: 干性因子标准化 (解决 6个SOX 的问题) ---
  mutate(Term_Display = case_when(
    grepl("POU5F1", Term, ignore.case=T) ~ "POU5F1 Targets",
    grepl("SOX2", Term, ignore.case=T) ~ "SOX2 Targets",
    grepl("NANOG", Term, ignore.case=T) ~ "NANOG Targets",
    grepl("MYC", Term, ignore.case=T) ~ "MYC Targets",
    grepl("KLF4", Term, ignore.case=T) ~ "KLF4 Targets",
    grepl("rRNA", Term, ignore.case=T) ~ "rRNA Processing",
    TRUE ~ Term_Display
  )) %>%
  
  # --- 规则 2: 表观遗传因子标准化 ---
  mutate(Term_Display = case_when(
    grepl("EZH2|SUZ12", Term, ignore.case=T) ~ "PRC2 Targets",
    grepl("TET[1-3]", Term, ignore.case=T) ~ "TET1/2/3 Targets",
    grepl("KDM2B", Term, ignore.case=T) ~ "KDM2B Targets",
    grepl("DNMT1", Term, ignore.case=T) ~ "DNMT1 Targets",
    TRUE ~ Term_Display
  )) %>%
  
  # --- 规则 3: 关键通路标准化 (合并同义词) ---
  mutate(Term_Display = case_when(
    grepl("Nervous|Neuronal|NEUROG1|GABA|Axon", Term_Display, ignore.case=T) ~ "Nervous System Development",
    grepl("Epithelial Mesenchymal|EMT", Term_Display, ignore.case=T) ~ "Epithelial Mesenchymal Transition",
    grepl("NF-kB|NFKB|Apoptosis", Term_Display, ignore.case=T) ~ "Apoptosis",
    grepl("Mitochondrial", Term_Display, ignore.case=T) ~ "Mitochondrial Function",
    grepl("TP53", Term, ignore.case=T) ~ "TP53 Targets",
    grepl("STAT3", Term, ignore.case=T) ~ "STAT3 Targets",
    TRUE ~ Term_Display
  )) %>% 
  
  # 如果没有被上面的规则改名，做一下基础清理
  mutate(Term_Display = Term_Display %>% 
           str_remove(" R-HSA.*") %>% 
           str_remove(" Homo sapiens.*") %>%
           str_trunc(50))

# C. 核心步骤：去重 (Deduplication)
# 对于每个 lncRNA (Group)，如果有名为 "SOX2 Targets" 的多条记录，只保留 P 值最小的那条
plot_data <- clean_data %>%
  group_by(lncRNA, Term_Display) %>%
  arrange(Adjusted.P.value) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>% # <--- 关键：只取第一名
  ungroup() %>%
  
  # D. 分类 (Category)
  mutate(Category = case_when(
    grepl(paste(keywords_map[["1_Stemness_Core"]], collapse="|"), Term, ignore.case=T) ~ "Pluripotency",
    grepl(paste(keywords_map[["2_Epigenetic_Mech"]], collapse="|"), Term, ignore.case=T) ~ "Epigenetic Regulation",
    grepl(paste(keywords_map[["3_Differentiation"]], collapse="|"), Term, ignore.case=T) ~ "Differentiation",
    grepl(paste(keywords_map[["4_Stress_Death"]], collapse="|"), Term, ignore.case=T) ~ "Stress & Cell Death",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )) %>%
  
  # E. 最终筛选：每个类别只展示 Top 5 (防止图太长)
  group_by(lncRNA, Category) %>%
  arrange(Adjusted.P.value) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  # F. 计算 LogP
  mutate(LogP = -log10(Adjusted.P.value)) %>%
  # 设个上限防止点太大
  mutate(LogP = ifelse(LogP > 10, 10, LogP)) %>%
  mutate(
    is_rRNA = ifelse(grepl("rRNA", Term_Display, ignore.case = TRUE), -1, 0),
    Term_Display = factor(Term_Display)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Category, is_rRNA, Term_Display) %>%
  mutate(Term_Display = factor(Term_Display, levels = unique(Term_Display)))

# ==============================================================================
# 3. 排序与绘图
# ==============================================================================

# 排序 LncRNA: CORE 在前
group_levels <- c("CORE", sort(setdiff(unique(plot_data$lncRNA), "CORE")))
plot_data$lncRNA <- factor(plot_data$lncRNA, levels = group_levels)

# 排序 Category
cat_levels <- c("Pluripotency Core", "Epigenetic Regulation", "Stress & Cell Death", "Differentiation")
plot_data$Category <- factor(plot_data$Category, levels = cat_levels)

p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = lncRNA, y = Term_Display, size = LogP, color = Category)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  
  # 分面展示
  facet_grid(Category ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 8), name = "-log10(Adj.P)") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Consolidated Functional Landscape",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7,
                               color = ifelse(levels(plot_data$lncRNA) == "CORE", "red", "black")),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(size = 0.1)
  )

ggsave("Fig_Landscape_Deduplicated.pdf", p, width = 7, height = 5.5)
print(p)
```

```{r}
combined_counts <- combined_counts_plus[, -665] 
rownames(combined_counts) <- combined_counts$gene_id 


keep_times <- c("0", "2", "4", "8", "16", "24", "48", "96")

col_data_filt <- col_data[as.character(col_data$time) %in% keep_times, ]

col_data_filt$time <- factor(as.character(col_data_filt$time), levels = keep_times)

combined_counts_filt <- combined_counts[, col_data_filt$sample_id]

combined_counts_filt <- as.matrix(combined_counts_filt)


# 创建一个临时的 DESeq 对象只用于计算归一化因子
# ==============================================================================
# Step 1: 标准化 (Normalization)
# ==============================================================================
# 确保使用 Normalized counts 以保证趋势真实
dds_norm <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = combined_counts_filt,
                                   colData = col_data_filt,
                                   design = ~ 1) 

dds_norm <- estimateSizeFactors(dds_norm)
norm_counts_mat <- counts(dds_norm, normalized = TRUE)

norm_counts_df <- as.data.frame(norm_counts_mat) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>%
  left_join(g2s, by = "gene_id") 

# ==============================================================================
# Step 2: 筛选 12 个干性崩塌基因 (The Collapse Core)
# ==============================================================================

# 你的最终名单：包含了干性、代谢、表观、信号维持
collapse_genes <- c("LINC00678", "HIPK2", "LOXL1", "SMAD3", "NCAM1","MIR302CHG")

# 强制设置因子水平，保证画图时按照你想要的顺序排列（可选，这里按字母或自定义）
# 这里我们让最核心的 NANOG, MYC 排在前面
ordered_genes <- c("LINC00678", "HIPK2", "LOXL1", "SMAD3", "NCAM1","MIR302CHG")

highlight_genes <- collapse_genes

# ==============================================================================
# Step 3: 数据处理
# ==============================================================================

plot_data_long <- norm_counts_df %>%
  filter(gene_name %in% highlight_genes) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(gene_id, gene_name),
    names_to = "sample_id",
    values_to = "normalized_counts"
  ) %>%
  left_join(col_data, by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(time = as.numeric(as.character(time)))
# ==============================================================================
# 高级可视化：12个干性崩塌基因在同一张图中的标准化表达趋势
# ==============================================================================

# 使用 Z-score 标准化处理表达量差异
plot_data_z <- plot_data_long %>%
  group_by(gene_name) %>%
  mutate(
    z_score = (normalized_counts - mean(normalized_counts)) / sd(normalized_counts)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 计算标准化后的均值和标准误
plot_summary_z <- plot_data_z %>%
  group_by(gene_name, time) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_z = mean(z_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_z = sd(z_score, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ymin = mean_z - se_z,
    ymax = mean_z + se_z
  )

myc_color <- "#D62728"  # 突出的红色用于MIR302CHG
other_colors <- c(
  "#1F77B4",  # SSH2 - 蓝色
  "#2CA02C",  # SSH1 - 绿色
  "#9467BD",  # SRGAP1 - 紫色
  "#8C564B",  # SRGAP2 - 棕色
  "#7F7F7F" # FUS - 灰色
)

# 为每个基因分配颜色
gene_colors <- setNames(c(myc_color, other_colors), ordered_genes)

# ==============================================================================
# 修正的绘图代码
# ==============================================================================

p_combined <- ggplot(plot_summary_z, aes(x = time, y = mean_z, group = gene_name)) +
  
  # 1. 为所有基因添加半透明的误差带背景
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = gene_name), 
              alpha = 0.15, show.legend = FALSE) +
  
  # 2. 添加趋势线 - MIR302CHG用粗线突出显示
  geom_line(aes(color = gene_name, size = gene_name, linetype = gene_name)) +
  
  # 3. 在关键时间点添加数据点
  geom_point(aes(color = gene_name, shape = gene_name), 
             size = 2, alpha = 0.8, data = plot_summary_z %>% filter(time %in% c(0, 4, 24, 96))) +
  
  # 4. 颜色、大小和线型映射 - 修正长度匹配问题
  scale_color_manual(values = gene_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = gene_colors) +
  scale_size_manual(values = setNames(c(1.5, rep(1, length(ordered_genes)-1)), ordered_genes)) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = setNames(rep("solid", length(ordered_genes)), ordered_genes)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = setNames(1:length(ordered_genes), ordered_genes)) +
  
  # 5. 坐标轴和标签
  labs(
    x = "Time (h)",
    y = "Z-score Normalized Counts",
    title = "Trend of lncRNA and Targets (DBN Inference)",
    color = "Gene",
    shape = "Gene",
    linetype = "Gene",
    size = "Gene"
  ) +
  
  # 6. 高水平期刊主题设置
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    # 文本元素
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, 
                              margin = margin(b = 10)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey40",
                                 margin = margin(b = 15)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    
    # 图例设置
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "italic"),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "lines"),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.2, "lines"),
    
    # 边距和背景
    plot.margin = margin(20, 30, 20, 20),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  ) +
  
  # 7. 坐标轴刻度优化
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 4, 8, 24, 48, 96),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))
  ) +
  
  # 8. 添加辅助网格线（期刊风格）
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(0, 24, 96), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.2)

# 预览图表
print(p_combined)

# ==============================================================================
# 保存高质量图片
# ==============================================================================

ggsave(
  filename = "Figure_combined_linc00678_target_ribbon.pdf",
  plot = p_combined,
  path = "~/RNAseq/RNAseq_FULL_MODEL/combined time/DBN_results/figures/trend_validation/",
  width = 8,          # 适合多基因图表的宽度

)
```

#单独画每个lncRNA
```{r}
library(STRINGdb)
library(dplyr)
library(tidygraph)
library(ggraph)
library(graphlayouts) 
library(ggsci) 
enriched_data <- filtered_data %>%
  # 过滤Group以"specific"结尾的行
  filter(str_ends(Group, "Specific")) %>%
  # 分离基因列表 (Genes列用分号分隔)
  mutate(gene_list = str_split(Genes, ";")) %>%
  # 展开成每行一个基因
  unnest(gene_list) %>%
  mutate(gene = str_trim(gene_list)) %>%
  # 清理基因名
  filter(!is.na(gene) & gene != "") %>%
  # 根据all_lnc_top_targets表过滤关系类型
  inner_join(all_lnc_top_targets %>% 
               filter(`final_relationship` %in% c("gene_regulates_lnc", "lnc_regulates_gene")) %>%
               dplyr::select(gene, `final_relationship`),
             by = "gene") %>%
  # 选择关键列
  dplyr::select(lncRNA = Group, Term, gene, Adjusted.P.value, Database, `final_relationship`) %>%
  distinct()
save(all_enrichment_results, filtered_data, enriched_data, file = "all_enriched_results.RData")
# 1. 初始化 STRING 数据库 (人类)
# score_threshold = 400 (中等置信度) 或 700 (高置信度)
string_db <- STRINGdb$new(species = 9606, version = "11.5", score_threshold = 400)

# 2. 准备你的 lncRNA 靶基因数据
# 假设 enriched_data 是你之前筛选好的 specific_genes
enriched_data <-all_lnc_top_targets %>% filter(`final_relationship` %in% c("gene_regulates_lnc", "lnc_regulates_gene")) 
target_lnc_name <- "LINC00678"
input_genes <- enriched_data %>%
  filter(str_detect(lncRNA, target_lnc_name)) %>% # 匹配名字
  pull(gene) %>%
  unique()

cat("输入基因数量:", length(input_genes), "\n")

# ==============================================================================
# 1. STRING 映射与互作查找
# ==============================================================================

# A. 将基因名映射到 STRING ID
genes_mapped <- string_db$map(data.frame(gene = input_genes), "gene", removeUnmappedRows = TRUE)

cat("成功映射到 STRING 的基因数:", nrow(genes_mapped), "\n")

# B. 获取这些基因内部的互作 (PPI)
# payload_id 是 STRING 的内部 ID
ppi_links <- string_db$get_interactions(genes_mapped$STRING_id)

# C. 将 STRING ID 转换回 Gene Symbol (为了画图让人看懂)
# 建立一个 ID -> Symbol 的对照表
id_to_symbol <- setNames(genes_mapped$gene, genes_mapped$STRING_id)

ppi_edges <- ppi_links %>%
  mutate(from_gene = id_to_symbol[from],
         to_gene = id_to_symbol[to]) %>%
  filter(!is.na(from_gene) & !is.na(to_gene)) %>% # 去掉映射失败的
  select(from = from_gene, to = to_gene, combined_score) %>%
  mutate(type = "PPI (STRING)") # 标记边的类型

# ==============================================================================
# 2. 整合 DBN 边 (LncRNA -> Gene)
# ==============================================================================

# 这些基因是 STRING 验证过的，我们只画这些
valid_genes <- unique(c(ppi_edges$from, ppi_edges$to))

dbn_edges_corrected <- enriched_data %>%
  # 1. 筛选出属于 PPI 网络中的基因
  filter(gene %in% valid_genes) %>%
  # 2. 匹配 lncRNA 名字
  filter(str_detect(lncRNA, target_lnc_name)) %>%
  # 3. 提取关系
  select(lncRNA, gene, final_relationship) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  # 4. 【核心步骤】根据关系交换起点终点
  mutate(from = ifelse(final_relationship == "lnc_regulates_gene", 
                       str_remove(lncRNA, "_Specific"), # 起点是 LncRNA
                       gene),                           # 起点是 Gene
         to   = ifelse(final_relationship == "lnc_regulates_gene", 
                       gene,                            # 终点是 Gene
                       str_remove(lncRNA, "_Specific")), # 终点是 LncRNA
         type = "DBN (Regulatory)",
         combined_score = 1000) %>% # 虚拟高分
  select(from, to, type, combined_score)

# 合并 PPI 边 (保持之前的 ppi_edges 不变)
all_edges_fixed <- rbind(ppi_edges, dbn_edges_corrected)

# 构建节点列表
all_nodes_fixed <- data.frame(name = unique(c(all_edges_fixed$from, all_edges_fixed$to))) %>%
  mutate(node_type = case_when(
    name == str_remove(target_lnc_name, "_Specific") ~ "LncRNA",
    name %in% hub_genes ~ "Protein Hub (Key Effector)",
    TRUE ~ "Target Gene"
  ))

# ==============================================================================
# 3. 寻找“核心蛋白” (Hub Genes in PPI)
# ==============================================================================
# 如果一个基因在 PPI 网络里连接了很多其他靶基因，它就是中间的 Mediator

# 计算 PPI Degree
ppi_degree <- table(c(ppi_edges$from, ppi_edges$to))
hub_genes <- names(ppi_degree[ppi_degree >= 3]) # 连接超过3个的算 Hub

# 构建节点属性
all_nodes <- data.frame(name = unique(c(all_edges$from, all_edges$to))) %>%
  mutate(node_type = case_when(
    name == target_lnc_name ~ "LncRNA",
    name %in% hub_genes ~ "Protein Hub (Key Effector)",
    TRUE ~ "Target Gene"
  ))

#识别cluster 功能
# 先生成临时对象计算聚类
temp_graph <- tbl_graph(nodes = all_nodes_fixed, edges = all_edges_fixed) %>%
  activate(nodes) %>%
  morph(to_undirected) %>%
  mutate(community = as.factor(group_louvain())) %>%
  unmorph()

# --- 查看每个 Cluster 里有哪些 Hub 基因 ---
# 通过看这些基因，你可以推断出这个 Cluster 的名字
cluster_info <- temp_graph %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  group_by(community) %>%
  summarise(
    Top_Genes = paste(head(name, 5), collapse = ", "), # 看前5个基因
    Count = n()
  )

print(cluster_info)
# ==============================================================================
# 4. 可视化 (ggraph)
# ==============================================================================

# 定义你的生物学标签映射
cluster_labels <- c(
  "1" = "Actin Cytoskeleton & GTPase",
  "2" = "Mito. Metabolism & Signaling",
  "3" = "RNA Processing & Translation",
  "4" = "Cell Cycle & Transcription",
  "5" = "Glucose Metabolism & Adhesion",
  "6" = "Chromatin & Epigenetics",
  "7" = "Membrane Dynamics"
)

cluster_labels_new <- c(
  "1"  = "Cell Cycle Arrest & Stress",
  "2"  = "Apoptosis & Lysosomal Pathway",
  "3"  = "TGF-beta & Nuclear Transport",
  "4"  = "Chromatin Remodeling (Polycomb)",
  "5"  = "Oxidative Stress & Lipid Metab.",
  "6"  = "Neuronal Synapse & Axon Guidance",
  "7"  = "Vesicle Trafficking & Exocytosis",
  "8"  = "Neuropeptides & Glycobiology",
  "9"  = "Ribosome Biogenesis",
  "10" = "Extracellular Matrix (ECM)"
)

# 重新构建 Graph (确保之前的数据准备步骤已运行)
final_graph <- temp_graph %>%
  activate(nodes) %>%
  mutate(
    degree = centrality_degree(mode = 'all'),
    font_face = ifelse(node_type == "Target Gene", "plain", "bold"),
    label_size = ifelse(node_type == "Target Gene", 3, 5)
  )

p <- ggraph(final_graph, layout = "stress") + 
  
  # --- 1. 画 PPI 边 (灰色) ---
  geom_edge_arc(aes(filter = type == "PPI (STRING)", alpha = combined_score), 
                color = "grey85", strength = 0.1, edge_width = 0.4) + 
  
  # --- 2. 画 DBN 边 (红色，带箭头) ---
  # 修复箭头方向逻辑（如果之前没修，这里要确保源数据是对的）
  geom_edge_link(aes(filter = type == "DBN (Regulatory)"), 
                 color = "#E64B35", edge_width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5,
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(4, 'mm'), type = "closed")) +
  
  # --- 3. 画节点 ---
  geom_node_point(aes(color = community, shape = node_type, size = node_type),
                  alpha = 0.9) +
  
  # --- 4. 标签 ---
  geom_node_text(aes(label = name, size = I(label_size), fontface = font_face), 
                 repel = TRUE, bg.color = "white", bg.r = 0.15, color = "black", max.overlaps = 30) +
  
  # --- 5. 样式 ---
  
  # 形状和大小
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("LncRNA" = 18, "Protein Hub (Key Effector)" = 19, "Target Gene" = 19)) +
  scale_size_manual(values = c("LncRNA" = 9, "Protein Hub (Key Effector)" = 6, "Target Gene" = 3)) +
  
  # 【关键修改】颜色映射 + 生物学标签
  scale_color_npg(name = "Functional Module (PPI Cluster)",
                  labels = cluster_labels_new) + 
  
  # 隐藏不必要的图例
  scale_edge_alpha_continuous(guide = "none") + 
  
  # 合并节点类型图例
  guides(
    shape = guide_legend(title = "Node Type", override.aes = list(size = 5), order = 1),
    size = guide_legend(title = "Node Type", order = 1),
    color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5), order = 2, ncol = 1) # 功能图例单列显示
  ) +
  
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "right", 
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10))

# 保存
ggsave("Network_LINC00678_Final_Annotated.pdf", p, width = 12, height = 9)
print(p)
```
